name: KJZZ Report On The Project Baccara Military Compatibility Permit Vote
update_frequency: One-time vote report with downstream permit follow-up
known_limitations: The report corroborates the May 6 vote and contemporaneous statements about remaining air-quality review, but it is not the fully executed County permit, the official motion and minutes, the final air permit, or evidence that military-compatibility conditions have been satisfied.
automation_notes: Use only to corroborate the reported 4-1 vote and statements made at the hearing. Replace or supplement it with the County's approved summary minutes or fully executed MCP when that exact record is accessible.
notes: Phase 55C vote corroboration. KJZZ reported that the Board of Supervisors voted 4-1 on May 6, 2026 to issue the military compatibility permit and that county and federal air-quality approvals still remained.
